- `validate_push` queries ignored paths only when a staged `D`/`R` exists (line 289).
- Its synthetic `ignored_work` retains only staged removals (line 300), so broadening the query condition alone would still miss the overlap.

Undo cannot recover those bytes. This is a statically confirmed validation gap and data-loss risk; I did not reproduce destructive cleanup.

- Keep snapshot eligibility on `everything_problem`. [Snapshots use a separate path](https://github.com/JKamsker/gitcraft/blob/47ecee32d0359abc240b95a4c6ff42db2f37a3dc/src/repo/partial_stash/mod.rs#L603) without stash cleanup and should remain eligible.
